notes.title: Saffron Fields — a new game from Low Polystan
notes.notes:
Oh gosh. I'm so glad to present you a new game:

[h1]Saffron Fields[/h1]
is an arcade tank game revolving around [b]physics rather than hitpoints[/b].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1768660/Saffron_Fields/
You play as a saffron farmer, whose homeland has been invaded by private military companies hired by a syndicate of opium producers. You must fight and save people, and bring peace to the Saffron Fields.

[h2]You'll have[/h2]
[b]A tank[/b] that can shoot, jump and do a somersault
A greedy, reckless, drug-dealing PMC, staffed by copters, fighters, digging tanks and mechas
Infinite fun of trying to [b]throw everybody from the edge[/b]
[b]Kickass, plunging into a battle trance soundtrack[/b] by Damscray

[h2]4 different game mods[/h2]
[list][*][b]Campaign[/b] — [b]tricky arenas[/b], cutscenes and [b]unique bossfights[/b]
[*][b]Endless[/b] — compete with saffron farmers around the world in [b]a global leaderboard[/b]
[*][b]Co-op[/b] — see how long you can survive with your friend in [b]local multiplayer[/b]
[*][b]Duel[/b] — [b]destroy your friendship[/b] by showing [b]ultimate tank skillz[/b][/list]
See yo on the Fields and in [b]highscores[/b]!

And let me remind you
[h1]Wishlisting[/h1]
will help the game, like, A Lot!

Have a nice one
Yours, Toster12D3

notes.title: The best of Unknown Pleasures 2019
notes.notes:
It’s been a weird, weird year for games. My perspective has been particularly odd and hard to square, as I’ve now been full time staff here at RPS for nearly six months. Six months! That’s … oh my god, I still haven’t extended my rent.

It’s quite strange suddenly being able to talk about games in real life without having to apologise, but other than that it’s nice. In that time I’ve played somewhere around 1,200 to 1,300 games (an exact count is impossible for boring reasons), almost all of them little known.

There have been many, many excellent games. There’s a refrain you see around the internet sometimes that “this was a bad year for games”, and I’ve honestly never understood it. I lived through the 2000s, people, I remember that wasteland. But this year, even after a solid 2018, has been so replete with interesting things to play that I cannot fathom how to be disappointed with the games. Sure, the industry, the culture, these are often garbage things for garbage people. But the games, man. The gaaames. Don’t hold it against them.

So here it is then. It’s time for the very best of Unknown Pleasures 2019. The finest of all that we’ve got through since last year, in a mostly random order.

notes.title: 1001st Hyper Tower is out now, bloody good
notes.notes:
After a brief period in Steam Early Access, the superb tower-climbing Arabic-styled roguelike FPS 1001st Hyper Tower was released in full yesterday.

I have installed exactly two trillion games on the RPS steam account. This is one of the very few that I still make time to play.

notes.title: Update 30.10.2019
notes.notes:
As-salamu alaykum!
We are at the finish line now. This is what we have today:
[list] [*] [u][b]Shortcuts[/b][/u] system is fully on! It is the way to start from the higher levels if you already climb your way to them at least once. Every time you die you can choose to Quick Restart or go to the [b]Garage Scene[/b]. Where appears all the vehicles you capture during Boss Fights. They can take you directly to the Bazaar, the Hammam or Cloud Spire levels.
[*] [u][b]New Tutorial[/b][/u] is much easier to begin with. It's also have some explanations about higher levels mechanics and perks gaining.
[*] [u][b]Speedrun Timer[/b][/u] will always be in the Pause Menu. But you also can pin it on top of HUD anytime you want to.
[*] I've start changing [u][b]Sound FX[/b][/u]. They should be much better than the old ones. But it takes time to set all of them at once.
[/list]
The main news: Release will be at [u][b]November 6[/b][/u] with a [u][b]17% discount[/b][/u]!
It would be a rough week so see ya soon!

notes.title: Update 29.09.2019
notes.notes:
I tried very hard to make the Tower more cosy inside and beautiful outside. But some new elements are also functional! 

[list]
[*] Wooden balks will make it easier to climb;
[*] Bridges in front of doors helps you to fall right in fron of pasages;
[*] Fragile tents will delay the fall and restore the triple jump abillity;
[*] The rooms themselves now have got furniture and chandeliers, depending on the level. And thanks to the new materials navigation became more easier.
[*] The Silk Road level has got Sleeping Silkworms and Dust Devils. 
[*] At the Bazaar you can find more Trees in the rollers and Gas Stations.
[*] Hammam got Pools knocking the fire off you. 
[*] Cloud Spire has Servers builded in walls and Acid Puddles.
[/list]

The Upgrade System has been completely redesigned. The price is now progressive and the effects are better synergistic.

The Boss Fights has been reworked: The Caravaneer became more stable and the Ziggurat Boss is now more personolized.
Mini-bosses can be finded now at all levels. They have much-needed upgrade points.
The Big Boss of the last level is added so far in test mode. 
But most importantly, there was a chain of Secret Bosses, without which you can not open the final battle!

As well:
[list]
[*] Added slide movement (to perform it you'll need to sit down while running using shift);
[*] Fixed the number of enemies in trap rooms;
[*] Added ability to edit FOV in the settings menu;
[*] New enemies at the last level (Nephilims, cyber genies and astronauts);
[*] The Gan Disk is added in test mode. Disk throwers can be another type of weapon in the future. As long as Acid Guns and maybe Storm Makers.
[/list]

That's all for now! Release is very soon. I will be very glad to feedback and bug reports. Hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: Update 27 June 2019
notes.notes:
[u]This log summarizes the changes and new features for the past month[/u]
[list]
[*] Color differentiation and redesign of usable objects like doorways, ladders, health dispensers.
[*] Another revision of the number of HP
[*] The markers! Will not let you miss the interesting places.
[*] Finding special maps will make it easier to find first aid kits and new weapons.
[*] Important markers remain even if you turn away.
[*] Pointers show the type of weapon in the box, which is important when you run out of ammo.
[*] The flares started bouncing off the walls. Now they arn't completely useless inside the rooms.
[*] Better collider platform for jumpers.
[*] Better aiming options.
[*] Reviewed pause menu.
[*] Track selection in the music menu.
[*] Weapons are no longer repeated in chests during a run. Цhat was especially bad at the start.
[/list]
And a lot of bug fixes! Stay tuned. The game will be finally ready next month. Which means a lot of work and updates coming soon.

notes.title: Unknown Pleasures: Wanderers Edition
notes.notes:
Sometimes you don’t know what you need until you have it. Lately it turns out I’ve needed a lot of soothing, which is fortunate because this week’s selection of the best indie games on Steam ranks highly on the alleviometer. We’ve the usual variety you’ve surely come to expect, and a bit less of the drama and thrills than average.

It is time, once more, for some long overdue Unknown Pleasures.

Chilling out, maxing and relaxing all cool this week: plague doctors, Arabian cyberpunks, and… underground goddamn monsters.

(more…)

notes.title: Update 04 May 2019
notes.notes:
[u]New:[/u]
[list]
[*] [b]Powerups[/b] - a new pick up things that are hidden on the level. For a while, they will allow you to regenerate and fly, carry a bottomless backpack with ammunition or fuel, enter the super bullet-time, and even throw a miniature black hole.
[*] [b]Shortcuts[/b] - will allow you to start immediately from the upper levels, if you already got to them ones. However, the last boss will require passage from the beginning!
[*] [b]Flying Elephants[/b] can be found around Bazaar level.
[*] Weapons geting closer to the camera when [b]aiming[/b], allowing much better aim. Especially [b]in slow-mo[/b].
[/list]
[u]Improvements:[/u]
[list]
[*] Weapons are scattered on the floor which encourages exploration.
[*] A large room inside each floor with a large group of enemies.
[*] The menu has a map, through which you can see what part of the game you have passed and where are you on the level!
[*] A small cut-scene after you fall from the tower.
[*] Health distributors have become more convenient and contain some tricks.
[/list]
There are aproximatly 12 updates left before the release. So stay tuned and [b]thanks for playing![/b]

notes.title: Update 12 April 2019
notes.notes:
Long story short!
[list]
[*] New animation of the [b]weapon crates[/b]
[*] New air explosions
[*] Improved LODs for vehicles (optimisation)
[*] [b]Reduced damage[/b] from [b]explosions[/b] to the hero
[*] Bug with memory allocation when [b]Ghouls[/b] resurrect
[*] No drop from resurrected enemies
[*] [b]2nd Mini-boss[/b] is a tricky bastard now!
[/list]
The new update will be about [b]Powerups[/b] and [b]Shortcuts[/b]. So you can start from the Second or maybe even the Third level, if you'll activate some things there.
Don't think that it will become easier! New enemies will balance all these things back to hell!

notes.title: Update 05 April 2019
notes.notes:
[b]New:[/b]
[list]
[*] First miniboss, who's dropping desirable hyper cell if you'll defeat him
[*] Separate HP bars for bosses
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed collisions with pickable items
[*] Crossbow bolts are now stronger and get stuck in walls a lot more often (they are collectable!!)
[*] Removed the kick impulse, without "Air Dash" perk
[*] You can now disable crosshair and/or laser sight in settings menu
[*] Hyper cell's number displays correctly
[*] Fixed slow-mo breakage because of the pause menu
[*] Volume sliders work linearly, not logarithmically
[*] Combined mouse sensitivity slider of both axes
[*] Reduced mouse smoothing and added the ability to disable it completely
[/list]
Thank you very much for the support and feedback! I'll try to do smth with [b]Weapon Chests[/b] as soon as possible. Also, there will be [b]more mini-bosses[/b] this week! The time we'll done with them, there'll be the time for [b]secret bosses[/b]. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Update 28 March 2019
notes.notes:
[b]New upgrades system:[/b]
[list]
[*] Explore the tower more! You now have to find [b]upgrade points[/b] and then convert them into super usefull perks on [b]workbenches[/b] (in separate rooms).
[*] Upgrade points will also drop from minibosses and secret crates.
[*] No HP upgrades that make you tough too soon.
However every crafted perk will give you [b]+2 max HP[/b].
[*] [b]Telekinetic[/b] perk now let you pick ammo and medkits from the great distance.
[*] New [b]Flame Kicks[/b] perk that stacks with stomps too.
[*] Fixed [b]Boosted Jump[/b] perk.
[*] [b]Air Dash[/b] perk looks nicer now.
[/list]
[b]Also:[/b]
[list]
[*] Some models are redesigned.
[*] Levels have names.
[*] Secret weapon storers contains better guns.
[*] YOU FELL!
[/list]

The track from the trailer just released on bandcamp!
You can check it out here:
https://competor.bandcamp.com/album/ginga

The thursdays feels nice to make updates. So I'll try to make a couple of [b]minibosses[/b] to the next one. Stay tuned and [b]thanks for playing[/b]!

The next update will be at [u]Thursday[/u].
Stay tuned and [b]thanks[/b] for playing!
